objective: Implement and verify the evidence-based improvement queue, deterministic ranking and deduplication, bounded automatic-execution policy, controlled PhaseAmendment lifecycle, outcome measurement, and idle behavior required by Phase 198.
preserved_behavior: Certified Phase 197 protected-main and production release evidence
Existing single-writer Governor event chain, leases, recovery, release controller, and sparse owner-invoked review policy
Existing application, authentication, graph, worker, database, and deployment behavior
Protected-main branch rules and provider credential boundaries
exclusions: No autonomous pricing, packaging, legal, customer-rights, public-commitment, architecture-replacement, or material-spending decision
No Governor self-edit execution, speculative refactoring, always-on market scraping, or work created merely to consume capacity
No duplicate project-management suite or product-runtime feature unrelated to the repository-local Development Governor
release_requirements: All nineteen Phase 198 acceptance gates pass with durable evidence
Duplicate evidence merges into one candidate and never creates duplicate tasks
Product-defining and owner-authority candidates cannot auto-approve or create code tasks
Maximum active-work budget, emergency reserve, quiet periods, and no-value idle behavior are enforced
Current origin/main reconciliation and protected-main required checks
Exact-main-SHA deployment for frontend, API, and worker
Migration verification, authenticated production smoke, state readback, ReleaseManifest, and verified rollback point
